projectDescription: A curated collection of end-to-end data science and analytics case studies covering NLP, machine learning, SQL analysis, and exploratory data analysis in Python and R.
keyFeatures: End-to-end NLP pipelines: sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and text similarity
Supervised ML workflows: classification (breast cancer, fake news) and regression (house prices)
Customer analytics: RFM segmentation and repurchase prediction with XGBoost/LightGBM
SQL data engineering: multi-table schema design, custom MySQL functions, and semantic views
Exploratory data analysis on sports stats, climate data, financial stocks, and NGO donors
Full Python/Pandas pipelines from raw CSV ingestion to insight generation
publicApiSurface: 01_schema.py — creates AccidentesBCN MySQL database with 4 related tables
02_load_staging.py — bulk-loads 150K+ CSV records into MySQL in batches
03_functions.py — defines categoria_edad(), tipo_vehiculo(), estado_persona() MySQL UDFs
05_analysis_queries.py — runs 8 analysis queries over the accident dataset
run_all.bat — batch script to execute the full Barcelona accidents pipeline
Analisis.ipynb (Estudio de recompra) — Logistic Regression / XGBoost / LightGBM repurchase model
Pre-processing and feature engineering.ipynb — house price feature engineering notebook
Supervised methods.ipynb — house price regression model comparison notebook
Analisis de reseñas.ipynb — fixauto.com review sentiment + topic modeling notebook
Analisis de sentimientos.ipynb — hotel review sentiment analysis + word cloud notebook
Breast cancer.ipynb — binary classification on the breast cancer dataset
Fake News.ipynb — fake news word frequency analysis and classification notebook
Similarity rate between two texts.ipynb — cosine/TF-IDF text similarity notebook
Clima de Barcelona.ipynb — Barcelona climate EDA notebook
Leo Messi.ipynb — Messi career goals exploratory analysis notebook
Zara.ipynb — Inditex (ITX) stock price analysis notebook
src/extraccion.py — data loading helper for online retail dataset
src/anejo.py — auxiliary utility functions for Estudio de recompra
